proof_attempt_summary: The run verified legal positive rational active-edge twins that agree on the refined sources but give p(Y)=23/48 versus 25/48, and proved the all-length binary serial five-target classification with the earliest-conditioned-coordinate criterion, pure loss/no gain, and sharp minimum k=2. It also repaired the arbitrary-exterior contraction theorem to use a zero-permitting macro codomain with source-admissible domains, and proved coordinatewise normalization sufficient but not necessary for fixed-target transport. The mathematics passed both panel reviews, but the completed package remained below the field paper-score floor because it lacks a complete characterization over the original source grammar, an arbitrary-source complete procedure, or production workflow evidence.
tldr: Source-specific conditioning can invalidate identification transport through a legal transit-cluster contraction. For \(K=\{T_1,E\}\), Definition 13 has receiver \(T_1\) and emitter \(E\); the inputs \(p(E)\) and \(p(Y\mid T_1,E)\) satisfy Definition 14(a) and 14(c), and \(p(Y)\) is an exterior Theorem-17 target. Nevertheless, positive rational active independent-error twins agree on both refined sources and give \(p(Y=1)=23/48\) and \(25/48\). These twins form a subclass of the published positive SCM class, so the disagreement refutes the universal anchor claim by class inclusion, while total probability identifies \(p(Y)\) over the full published macro class from \(p(\tau)\) and \(p(Y\mid\tau)\). Within \(F_{\mathrm{serial}}\), the all-length five-target decision vector is preserved exactly when the earliest coordinate in \(C\) belongs to \(S\); this positive half is restricted to \(F_{\mathrm{serial}}\) and does not transfer to a broader superclass. For arbitrary finite exteriors under explicit contraction closure, checked coordinatewise recovery of every used macro source is sufficient but not necessary for a fixed target: fiber constancy is the semantic criterion, and an explicit separating class proves strictness. A complete characterization of when coordinatewise source recovery is necessary, and arbitrary-source algorithmic completeness, remain open.
gap: The anchor paper's Definition 14 permits different emitter-containing subsets in different sources, while Theorems 17 and 21 transport identification and formulas without an explicit condition identifying the conditional weights needed to collapse extra internal conditioning coordinates. The earlier full-joint transit-cluster theorem does not face this information loss.
